findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1/loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
Simplified Chinese totpStep1 replaced with Traditional Chinese
Verifier crashes when the English counterpart file is missing
Anchor check is order-dependent and replaces only the first occurrence
Mutable instance fields and unused/misspelled members
Test fixtures are malformed or weak

response:
## 1) Severity: HIGH | Type: Bug Title: Lithuanian totpStep1/loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text Affected: - themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties:101-101 - themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties:71-71 Explanation: The Lithuanian translation was replaced with an Italian string ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:"). Lithuanian users will see Italian text. Proposed fix: ~~~properties totpStep1=Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone: ~~~ ## 2) Severity: HIGH | Type: Bug Title: Simplified Chinese totpStep1 replaced with Traditional Chinese Affected: - themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties:112-112 Explanation: The zh_CN file now contains a Traditional Chinese string ("在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一："), which is the wrong locale. It should be Simplified Chinese. Proposed fix: ~~~properties totpStep1=在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一： ~~~ ## 3) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug Title: Verifier crashes when the English counterpart file is missing Affected: - misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:73-80 Explanation: The English file path is derived by regex substitution on the absolute path. The regex `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` can match earlier in the path, for example in directory names containing underscores. If the English file is missing, a RuntimeException is thrown instead of a reported message. Files already named `_en` that have no English sibling also fail. Additionally, `resources-community` to `resources` mapping does not cover the admin-ui `maven-resources-community` paths correctly, which works only by accident. Proposed fix: ~~~java // Derive the name only from the file name, and handle a missing file gracefully File en = new File(file.getParentFile().getAbsolutePath().replace("resources-community","resources"), file.getName().replaceAll("_[^_.]+(_[^_.]+)?\\.properties$", "_en.properties")); ~~~ ## 4) Severity: MEDIUM | Type: Bug Title: Anchor check is order-dependent and replaces only the first occurrence Affected: - misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:150-162 Explanation: Anchors are matched positionally against the English anchors. A translation that reorders tags will be rejected. After validation, `replaceFirst` with a quoted string is fine, but any anchor tags left unmatched in English are never reported when the translation has fewer anchors. Also, the check validates only the tag text; `` attributes are allowed to be identical to English, which is intended, but `]*>` can span odd content. The `key` parameter is unused. Proposed fix: ~~~java // Compare multiset of anchors; also report when the English has anchors missing from the translation if desired. ~~~ ## 5) Severity: LOW | Type: Maintainability Title: Mutable instance fields and unused/misspelled members Affected: - misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:58-63 - misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:139-139 Explanation: `POLICY_*` and `HTML_TAGS` are non-static, non-final instance fields, so they are rebuilt for every file. The method name `santizeAnchors` is misspelled. The `commons-text` dependency is declared with a redundant `compile` scope. Proposed fix: ~~~java private static final PolicyFactory POLICY_SOME_HTML = ...; private static final Pattern HTML_TAGS = ...; ~~~ ## 6) Severity: LOW | Type: Test Title: Test fixtures are malformed or weak Affected: - misc/theme-verifier/src/test/resources/illegalHtmlTag_en.properties:17-17 Explanation: The fixture `Some
tag`. Proposed fix: ~~~properties key=Some
tag
~~~

true_positives.golden_comment: The translation is in Italian instead of Lithuanian. This should be translated to Lithuanian to match the file's locale (messages_lt.properties).
true_positives.matched_candidate: Lithuanian totpStep1/loginTotpStep1 translation was replaced with Italian text - Lithuanian users will see Italian text instead of Lithuanian
true_positives.reasoning: The candidate issue identifies the exact same problem as the golden comment - that Italian text was used instead of Lithuanian translation in what should be a Lithuanian locale file. Both comments point out that Lithuanian users will see Italian text, which is the core issue.

true_positives.golden_comment: The totpStep1 value uses Traditional Chinese terms in the Simplified Chinese file (zh_CN), which is likely incorrect for this locale. Please verify the locale‑appropriate translation.
true_positives.matched_candidate: Simplified Chinese (zh_CN) totpStep1 was replaced with Traditional Chinese text - wrong locale for the file
true_positives.reasoning: The candidate issue identifies exactly the same problem as the golden comment: the totpStep1 value in the Simplified Chinese (zh_CN) file contains Traditional Chinese text instead of Simplified Chinese, which is incorrect for that locale. Both comments point to the same localization/translation error.

true_positives.matched_candidate: Method name santizeAnchors is misspelled (should be sanitizeAnchors)
true_positives.reasoning: The candidate issue identifies exactly the same problem as the golden comment - the method name 'santizeAnchors' is misspelled and should be 'sanitizeAnchors' (missing the letter 'i'). Both comments point to the same typo in the same method name.

true_positives.golden_comment: Field HTML_TAGS should be declared as 'private static final' following Java naming conventions for constants
true_positives.matched_candidate: POLICY_* and HTML_TAGS are non-static, non-final instance fields that get rebuilt for every file instead of being shared
true_positives.reasoning: The golden comment identifies that HTML_TAGS should be declared as 'private static final' following Java naming conventions for constants. The candidate issue mentions that HTML_TAGS (along with POLICY_* fields) are 'non-static, non-final instance fields that get rebuilt for every file instead of being shared'. Both comments identify the same underlying problem - that HTML_TAGS should be static final but currently isn't. The candidate uses different wording (focusing on the performance/efficiency aspect of rebuilding) but points to the same code issue.

false_positives.candidate: Verifier crashes when English counterpart file is missing - regex substitution on absolute path can match earlier in path (e.g., directory names with underscores), and missing files throw RuntimeException instead of reporting a message
resources-community to resources mapping does not correctly cover admin-ui maven-resources-community paths
Anchor check is order-dependent and replaces only the first occurrence - translations that reorder tags will be rejected incorrectly
Anchor validation doesn't report when English has anchors that are missing from the translation (when translation has fewer anchors)
The key parameter in anchor check method is unused
commons-text dependency is declared with redundant compile scope
Test fixture 'Some <div>tag</div' has unterminated closing tag - exercises malformed HTML rather than just disallowed element

false_negatives.golden_comment: The anchor sanitization logic has a potential issue where it consumes English matcher groups without proper validation. If the translated text has more anchor tags than the English text, this could lead to incorrect validation results.
